name: Novel Sampling Scheme for Slice Based Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that generates proxy geometry using multiple object-aligned 2D texture stacks clipped by planes extending from the front-facing edges of the volume's bounding box in the viewing direction, eliminating stack-switching artifacts and jagged boundary artifacts.
summary: This technique eliminates stack-switching artifacts by simultaneously rendering multiple object-aligned 2D texture stacks clipped by view-direction planes, avoiding the color shifts of single-stack methods.
